title: Amazon DynamoDB Query Root and Traversal Closure
supportedOperation: A low-level DynamoDB Query assessed from an initial response or an exact LastEvaluatedKey to ExclusiveStartKey traversal bundle.
negativeProposition: The exact root Query returned zero Items across every validated page.
notes: A final response requested with ExclusiveStartKey is segment-only unless prior pages are supplied and linked.
LastEvaluatedKey means the root query traversal has not ended.
